trans-unit.source: Do you need ALL OF IT? Get the All-In-One Pack to acquire all together what all the other creation centre packs have to offer: - Tournaments Pack - Career Mode Pack - Teams Pack - Yet 10 More Teams Pack - Licensor Pack - Serious Editor Pack

Craving for playing CAREER MODE with your Creation Centre teams? Get the Career Mode Pack to expand your Creation Centre experience!
By getting the Career Mode Pack you will be entitled to: - Use Creation Centre teams in Career Mode by swapping teams when setting up a New Career. - Add and play in Career Mode with a downloaded Creation Centre league by selecting it when setting up a New Career.

Must use LICENSED STADIUMS, PLAYERS and TEAMS? Get the Licensor Pack! By getting the Licensor Pack you will be entitled to: - Use licensed players on the creation centre teams you create on the website. - Use licensed teams on the creation centre tournaments you create on the website. - Select licensed stadiums for the teams and tournaments you create on the website.

Are you really SERIOUS into CUSTOMISATION? Get the Serious Editor Pack to expand your Creation Centre experience! By getting the Serious Editor Pack you will be entitled on the website to serious editing functionality like: - The ability to assign a second celebration running and ending styles. - The ability to choose secondary/tertiary/and forth preferred positions for each player. - The ability to choose a tournament ball. - The ability to select a third kit. - The ability to assign a custom formation. - And much more!

Starving for MORE TEAMS? Get the Teams Pack to expand your Creation Centre experience!
By getting the Teams Pack you will be entitled to: - Additional 50 team creation slots on the website. - Additional 24 team download slots. - Ability to upload a custom team logo too all the teams you create on the website.
Starving for EVEN MORE TEAMS? Get the Yet 10 More Teams Pack to be entitled to additional 10 team download slots.

Do you need MORE TOURNAMENTS? Get the Tournaments Pack to expand your Creation Centre experience! By getting the Tournaments Pack you will be entitled to: - 5 tournament creation slots on the website. - 5 tournament download slots.

Try and then buy the UEFA EURO 2012™ expansion pack for EA SPORTS FIFA 12! Play the UEFA EURO 2012™ with authentic teams and players. Build your dream team and dominate Europe in the brand new Expedition mode. Play challenges based off the real tournament. Compete online for glory in the Online UEFA EURO 2012™. Text languages supported: English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, and Polish.

Enter the world of Live Season and rewrite your club’s history! This trial allows you to replay up to 5 real world matches in the brand-new My Live Season game mode. Once you’ve activated the trial, go back to the Main Menu, enter the Live Season menu and select My Live Season. Pick a league and any club within it to play for 5 matches. Like what you see? Come back to the FIFA 12 Store to purchase the full version.
